claim_boundary: The calculations screen known error mechanisms. Edge, adsorption, leakage, mixing and preload terms are accepted only through the specified physical blanks and validation tests.

edge_control.acceptance: At the primary 50 x 50 mm window, the fitted perimeter term plus regression uncertainty must be at most 1.5% of the corrected net signal.

mandatory_run_sequence: Individual chamber volume calibration after all internals are installed.
Impermeable-coupon wall-storage and thermal blank with fans running.
Three-aperture edge regression at matched conditions.
Randomised ABBA polarity blocks with both sensor locations logged.
Post-run zero-current and impermeable-coupon drift checks.

seal_design.acceptance: Guard signal and blank-derived leakage correction must each remain within the allocated leakage error; otherwise reject the run.
seal_design.design: Two continuous EPDM 70 Shore A static face seals separated by a vented and monitored guard groove.

selected_construction.wetted_surface: Structural aluminium outside the gas boundary; removable smooth non-porous metal liner on bulk wetted surfaces. Keep exposed PEEK to the minimum required insulating cartridge land.

status: BUILD BASIS; fabrication release still requires physical validation
